entries.en: Hey, now what's a pretty girl like you doing in this kinda biz, anyway?
entries.ro: Hei, ce cauți o tipă ca tine prin afacerile astea, oricum?
entries.ro_m: Hei, ce cauți un tip ca tine prin afacerile astea, oricum?

entries.en: Same as every other bonebrain like you – working.
entries.ro: La fel ca orice alt cretin ca tine – muncesc.

entries.en: God, sounds like it's someone's time of the month.
entries.ro: Doamne, parcă are cineva ciclul azi.

entries.en: Shut up, or I'll make you bleed out of places you don't wanna.
entries.ro: Taci, că te fac să sângerezi pe unde nu vrei.

entries.en: See the word from Vic? 'Nother job just come in down the wire.
entries.ro: Ai văzut ce-a zis Vic? A mai picat o treabă pe fir.

entries.en: You were supposed to cover your tracks.
Mhm. A little too well. HQ won't be happy about the trail of bodies you left behind.
entries.ro: Mhm. Cam prea bine. HQ-ului o să nu-i placă dâra de morți pe care ați lăsat-o în urmă.

entries.en: If they have a problem, they can call me. I don't have to answer to you.
entries.ro: Dacă au o problemă, să mă sune. Nu-ți dau socoteală ție.

entries.en: Bust a few kneecaps and they'll stop. Easy.
entries.ro: Spargi câteva genunchi și se opresc. Simplu.
